pull.title: KAFKA-20803: Demultiplex batched persister responses once (ReadStateHandler)
pull.body:
Follow-up to #22835 for [KAFKA-20803](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-20803).

-  Remove repeated scans of batched `READ_SHARE_GROUP_STATE` responses.
- Build one shared `PartitionResultIndex` per batch and let `ReadStateHandler` look up its result by topic ID and partition.
- It Reduce demultiplexing from O(N ^ 2) to average O(N), using O(N) temporary indexing memory while preserving payloads, errors, and retries.

- Coverage includes cross-topic routing, READ payload preservation, missing partitions, and null responses.
